t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are two colors of baskets. Each gnome color is linked to a specific basket, but that connection will have to be learned from experience. Which basket awards the most points alternates, so if basket A is only yielding a small amount of points, I should switch to basket B. The points the high yielding basket rewards will start to decrease before the switch, so I should change basket colors when the points start to decline.

vb_textbox.text: There are two colors of baskets- red and yellow. The color of gnome that you pick determines which basket you see in the forest. Red, brown, pink and purple gnomes result in the red basket. Yellow, orange, green and blue gnomes result in the yellow basket. One color of basket usually rewards significantly more points than the other. If the yellow basket is giving 0-4 points, the red basket might be in the 5-9 point range. The points fluctuate a lot, but the better choice of basket usually runs in streaks. If the red basket is rewarding 5-9 points for a number of rounds, but starts to drop to 4 or fewer- it's a good sign that the yellow basket might starting to increase soon (but not always). Try to stick with what's working on the 5x rounds, but use the 1x rounds to compare the baskets.
